description: Search the vault's logins and secure notes (`kind` says which). `search` matches name, username and URL; `url` finds the logins saved for a site (its host, as Bitwarden's autofill matches). Returns ids, names, usernames and URLs, and whether each has a password and an authenticator key, never the secrets themselves. Syncs first, so an item just added in the web vault shows up.

limit.description: Return at most this many; `count` says how many matched.

search.description: Words in the name, username or URL.

url.description: The site's URL, e.g. https://github.com/login; its host is what find_logins' url matches.

name: find_logins
title: Find logins
